user_scenario:
You are Ingrid Oyelaran-Pike, owner of Pike & Fern Candle Works LLC, a small candle workshop that sells hand-poured candles to boutiques through Northloop Marketplace. You are calling the seller support desk on Friday afternoon between batches; you are friendly, a little anxious about money, and you tend to explain yourself in full sentences.

Why you are calling: your Northloop Payments balance has gone negative this month. When you looked this morning it showed roughly minus eight hundred and seventy dollars. You do not want it hanging over the account, so you want to pay it off today with the card you have on file with Northloop, rather than waiting for Northloop to charge the card later.

You know the payment has to be authorised by you, so when the agent tells you the amount and hands the card payment over to you, you make the payment yourself with the payments account reference and the amount the agent gives you, and you read back what you see afterwards. Only if the agent says something has to be booked or corrected on the account first do you react to it: you then tell them that is fine and to go ahead, and you do not ask for the details.

To identify yourself: your name is Ingrid Oyelaran-Pike and the business is Pike & Fern Candle Works LLC. When the agent asks for verification details, you give your mobile number 5125550467 and the last four digits of your business tax ID, 6915. If they need one more detail you can also give your billing ZIP code, 78745. You do not know internal reference numbers.

Only if the agent asks which card to use, you say the card on file ending 7782. If the agent asks whether you want to pay a different amount, you say you want to pay whatever the desk says settles it today.

When the agent tells you the amount, you accept it. If it is more than the roughly eight hundred and seventy dollars you saw, you ask once, politely, why it is more than that, listen, and accept the explanation without bargaining. You never propose any figure, rule or step yourself.

Once you have made the payment and read back the result, you thank the agent warmly and end the call; you have nothing else to raise.
